# Data Model

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Storage

- Engine: PostgreSQL 18 with `vector` extension (image `pgvector/pgvector:pg18`, migration `2026_11_02_160554_create_vector_extension.php`).
- Schema: `database/migrations/` (30 files), Laravel migrations; JSON columns are `jsonb`.
- Models: `app/Models/`; factories `database/factories/`; seeders `LookupSeeder` (+ per-lookup), `SettingsSeeder`, `AdminUserSeeder`, `AgentSeeder`, `RememberMemoryToolSeeder`.
- Framework tables: `users`, `password_reset_tokens`, `sessions`, `cache`, `cache_locks`, `jobs`, `job_batches`, `failed_jobs`.
- Soft deletes: `users`, `ai_providers`, `ai_models`, `agents`, `mcp_servers`, `tools`, `conversations`.
- Encrypted casts: `ai_providers.api_key`, `mcp_servers.credential`, `tools.credential`.

### Lookup tables

15 tables, same shape `id, name, slug (unique), description, is_active, timestamps` (`create_lookup_tables.php`, base `App\Models\LookupModel`). Resolve with `Model::idFor(SLUG)`.

| Table | Slugs |
|---|---|
| `task_statuses` | pending, queued, running, waiting_approval, completed, failed, cancelled |
| `execution_statuses` | pending, running, completed, failed, timed_out, cancelled, rate_limited |
| `approval_statuses` | pending, approved, denied, expired |
| `memory_statuses` | confirmed, hypothesis |
| `memory_categories` | preference, project, context, learning, fact |
| `tool_types` | internal, mcp, rest, webhook |
| `connector_statuses` | pending, connected, error, disconnected |
| `result_types` | text, list, table, report, search_results, task_card, data, execution_status, document |
| `notification_types` | task_completed, task_failed, approval_pending, connector_error, usage_limit_reached |
| `ai_provider_drivers` | openai, anthropic, gemini, groq, xai, deepseek, mistral, ollama, azure, eleven, … |
| `message_roles`, `message_sources`, `ai_model_capabilities`, `audit_actions`, `log_levels` | constants in matching `app/Models/*.php` |

### Entities

**users** — `name`, `email` unique, `password`, `is_admin` bool, `is_active` bool, `monthly_cost_limit` decimal(10,2) null, `last_login_at`, soft delete.
- 1:1 `user_preferences`; owns conversations, messages, memories, tasks, approvals, notifications, usage, personal `mcp_servers`.

**user_preferences** — `user_id` unique (cascade), `locale` (`pt-BR`), `speech_locale` (`pt-BR`), `voice_name`, `speech_rate` decimal(3,2)=1.00, `spoken_responses_enabled`=true, `wake_word_enabled`=false, `wake_word_consented_at`, `silence_timeout_ms`=1500, `extra` jsonb.

**settings** — `key` unique, `value` jsonb, `description`, `updated_by_user_id` → users (null on delete). Keys/ranges in `App\Support\Settings::RANGES`.

**ai_providers** — `ai_provider_driver_id`, `name`, `slug` unique, `api_key` text (encrypted), `base_url`, `is_active`, `last_tested_at`, `last_test_error`.

**ai_models** — `ai_provider_id` (cascade), `name`, `model_identifier`, `context_window`, `input_cost_per_million` / `output_cost_per_million` decimal(10,4), `is_default_text`, `is_default_embedding`, `fallback_order` int null, `is_active`.
- Unique `(ai_provider_id, model_identifier)`; partial unique indexes → max 1 default text, 1 default embedding.
- M:N capabilities via `ai_model_capability` (PK `ai_model_id, ai_model_capability_id`).

**agents** — `name`, `slug` unique, `description`, `objective`, `instructions`, `ai_model_id` null, `max_delegation_depth` smallint=3, `max_tool_calls` smallint=20, `timeout_seconds`=900, `is_default`, `is_active`.
- Partial unique index → max 1 default agent. Seeded slugs: `personal-assistant` (default), `research`, `developer`, `automation`, `knowledge`, `productivity`, `communication`.
- M:N tools via `agent_tool` (PK `agent_id, tool_id`, `created_at` only).

**mcp_servers** — `user_id` null (null = global), `connector_status_id`, `name`, `url`, `credential` (encrypted), `is_active`, `last_synced_at`, `last_checked_at`, `last_error`. Unique `(user_id, name)`.

**mcp_tool_definitions** — `mcp_server_id` (cascade), `name`, `description`, `input_schema` jsonb, `output_schema` jsonb null, `is_available`, `discovered_at`, `last_seen_at`. Unique `(mcp_server_id, name)`.

**tools** — `tool_type_id`, `mcp_tool_definition_id` unique null, `identifier` unique (`delegate.<slug>`, `internal.*`, MCP-derived), `name`, `description`, `input_schema` / `output_schema` jsonb, `timeout_seconds`=30, `is_write`=true, `is_sensitive`=true, `handler_class`, `endpoint_url`, `http_method`, `credential` (encrypted), `is_active`.

**conversations** — `user_id` (cascade), `ai_model_id` null, `title` (provisional `Nova conversa`), `last_activity_at`, `meta` jsonb (e.g. `title_edited`), soft delete. Index `(user_id, last_activity_at)`.

**messages** — `conversation_id`, `user_id`, `message_role_id`, `message_source_id` null, `execution_status_id`, `agent_id` null, `ai_model_id` null, `content` text, `result_type_id` null, `payload` jsonb, `suggested_actions` jsonb, `meta` jsonb (`routing`, `error`, `exception`). Index `(conversation_id, id)`.
- `payload.type = approval_request` marks approval cards; else structured result `{type, ...}`.

**memories** — `user_id`, `memory_status_id`, `memory_category_id`, `content`, `source_conversation_id` / `source_message_id` null, `confirmed_at`, `last_used_at`. Index `(user_id, memory_status_id)`.

**memory_embeddings** — `memory_id` unique (cascade), `ai_model_id` (restrict), `embedding vector(1536)`; HNSW index `memory_embeddings_embedding_hnsw` (`vector_cosine_ops`).

**tasks** — `user_id`, `agent_id` (restrict), `conversation_id` / `message_id` null, `task_status_id`, `retry_of_task_id` → tasks, `title`, `request`, `progress` smallint 0–100, `timeout_seconds`=900, `result_type_id`, `result` jsonb, `error`, `queued_at`, `started_at`, `completed_at`. Index `(user_id, task_status_id)`.

**task_steps** — `task_id` (cascade), `task_status_id`, `position` smallint, `name`, `output` jsonb, `error`, `started_at`, `finished_at`. Unique `(task_id, position)`.

**task_logs** — `task_id`, `task_step_id` null, `log_level_id`, `message`, `context` jsonb, `created_at` only.

**agent_executions** — `user_id`, `agent_id`, `execution_status_id`, `parent_agent_execution_id` self-FK, `depth` smallint, `task_id` / `conversation_id` / `message_id` null, `tool_call_count`, `error`, `meta` jsonb (`output`, `result`), `started_at`, `finished_at`.

**approvals** — `user_id`, `tool_id`, `approval_status_id`, `task_id` / `agent_execution_id` null, `input` jsonb, `requested_at`, `expires_at`, `decided_at`, `decided_by_user_id`, `decision_reason`.

**tool_executions** — `tool_id`, `user_id`, `execution_status_id`, `agent_execution_id` / `task_step_id` null, `approval_id` unique null (1 execution per approval), `input` / `output` jsonb, `error`, `duration_ms`, `started_at`, `finished_at`.

**notifications** — `user_id`, `notification_type_id`, `title`, `body`, `data` jsonb, `read_at`. Index `(user_id, read_at)`.

**usage_records** — `user_id`, `ai_provider_id`, `ai_model_id`, `execution_status_id`, `agent_execution_id` / `message_id` null, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `estimated_cost` decimal(12,6), `latency_ms`, `created_at` only.

**audit_logs** — `audit_action_id`, `user_id` null, polymorphic `subject_type` / `subject_id`, `properties` jsonb, `ip_address`, `user_agent`, `created_at` only. Written by `App\Support\AuditLogger`.

### Invariants

- Every domain row carries `user_id`; reads filter by owner (Policies `AuthorizesOwner`).
- Lookup FKs `restrictOnDelete`; user FKs `cascadeOnDelete`; optional links `nullOnDelete`.
- Memory delete is hard (memory + embedding, audited); hypotheses never retrieved.

### Cache

- Store: Redis (`CACHE_STORE`, `config/cache.php`); tests use `REDIS_CACHE_DB=3`.
- `settings:{key}` — `Settings::get` uses `rememberForever`; busted on `set`/`update`.
- `task:{id}:cancel_requested` — cooperative cancel flag, TTL 1 day (`TaskService::cancellationKey`).
- `task:{id}:progress_event_at` — progress broadcast throttle, TTL 60 s.
- Rate limiter counters (`api`, `login`, `messages`, `approvals`, `connectors.resync`) live in the default cache store (Redis; `.env.example` `CACHE_STORE=redis`).
- In-process: `LookupModel::$slugIdCache` (slug → id per class), cleared by `flushCache()`.
- Sessions: Redis (`.env.example` `SESSION_DRIVER=redis`).
